title: Aging Populations
description: The global demographic landscape is shifting, with significant increases in the elderly population across various countries. South Korea's elderly population has grown from 5% in 1990 to 20% in 2024, and is projected to reach 50% by 2062. Similarly, Canada's population aged 65 and older has more than doubled since 1991. These trends highlight the growing impact of aging populations on national demographics.
